name: ember-emotional-computing
description: Ember - a local-first Emotional Computing System: computational emotional mechanics (emotional decay, time-lock revisitation, honesty constraints) with fully offline, encrypted storage
author: Jeremiah Ayeni (https://github.com/Jeremy-1011)

scripts.services: concurrently -k -n csharp,python -c blue,green "dotnet run --project services/validation-engine" "python services/reflective-modules/app.py"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n app,csharp,python -c yellow,blue,green "vite build && electron ." "dotnet run --project services/validation-engine" "python services/reflective-modules/app.py"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n vite,csharp,python -c yellow,blue,green "vite" "dotnet run --project services/validation-engine" "python services/reflective-modules/app.py"
scripts.electron: concurrently -k -n app,csharp,python -c yellow,blue,green "vite build && electron ." "dotnet run --project services/validation-engine" "python services/reflective-modules/app.py"
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run build:services && electron-builder
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build && npm run build:services && electron-builder --dir
